name: IC Analog — SPI — DFN
description: Analog IC cluster containing surface-mount SPI devices in DFN packages with exposed pads, including ADC and DAC components.
selection_hints: Select for analog IC applications requiring an SPI serial interface.
Choose for SMD designs using 8-pin or 10-pin DFN packages with exposed pads.
Match footprint dimensions to layout requirements (3x2mm or 3x3mm DFN).
avoid_when: The application requires through-hole components or non-DFN package families.
Interfaces other than SPI are required.
Exposed pad sizes or pin pitch do not match PCB footprint land patterns.
